so'i skye bo'i chos rnams sbyin par byed pa yang ma yin/ 'dor bar byed pa yang ma yin/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams sbyin par byed pa yang ma yin/ 'dor bar byed pa yang ma yin/ sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams sbyin par byed pa yang ma yin/ 'dor bar byed pa yang ma yin no/ /rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni 'dus byas kyi khams gyona'ador bar byed pa yang ma yin mi/ 'dus ma byas kyi khams sbyin par byed pa yang ma yinasano/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams byung yang rung / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams ma byung yang rung / chos kyi dbyings kyi tshul 'di ni gnas pa nyid de/ de de bzhin gshegs pas mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas shing ④mngon par thugs su chud de/ mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas shing / mngon par thugs su chud nas kyang / gsung ba dang / rnam par 'grel ba dang ske/ rnam par 'byed pa dang / ston par mdzad pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas lha'i bu 'bum phrag rab tu mang po dag steng gi bar snang la 'khod nas/ ca co dang ske/ ga zhamachosa'adon cing / lha'i me tog ye.ud pa la dang / pad ma dang /ku mu da dang / pad ma dkar po dang / man da ger ba dag gis gtor nas/'di skad du/ a la la 'dzam bu'i gling du chos kyi 'khor lo lan gnyis bskor ba 'di mthong ngo / /zhes tshig tu yang brjod do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di bstan pa na/ de las lha'i bu stong phrag du ma dag gis mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'ad sa kyis tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rab 'byor dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni chos gang yang 30wa 200

'jug par bya ba'am/ ldog par bya ba'i phyir nye bar gnas pa ma yin pas/rab 'byor 'di ni chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba gnyis pa yang ma yin/ gcig pa yang ma yin no/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das gang gi tshe/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni 3)chos gang yang 'jug par bgyi ba'amal/ldog par bgyi ba'i slad du nye bar gnas pa ma lags pa'i dngos po ma mchis pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pas stong ngo / /de bzhin du bsam gtan dang / brtson du'agrus dang / bzod pa dang ske/ tshul khrims dang / sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ni sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pas stong ngo / /nang stong pa nyid ni nang stong pa nyid kyis stong ngo / /dngos po med pa 'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar ni dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyis stong ngo / /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams ni dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyis stong ngo / /de bzhin du yang dag parasnyisrong ba dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang / dbang po dang / stobs dang / byang chub kyi yan lag dang / lam rnams ni lam gyis stong ngo / /stobs bcu ni stobs bcus stong ngo / /mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad ni sangs rgyas kyi chos sa ma 'dres pa rnams kyis stong ngo / /rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu ni rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bus stong ngo / /de bzhin du lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang / phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang / dgra bcom pa nyid dang / rang sangs rgyas nyid dang ske/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ni rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid 38—201

kyis stong ngo / /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/dngos po 1ma mchis pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa tsho 'di ni che ba lags te/ chos thams cad kyang chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin gyis stong la/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyang ske/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la brten nas/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba yangs/ chos gang yang mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba ma mchis shing / chos kyi 'khor lo yang skor gel chos gang yang 'jug par bgyid pa'am/ ldog par bgyid pa yang ma mchis te/ chos gang yang yongs su mthong ba yang ma mchis 'kho/ chos gang yang yongs su ma mthong ba yang ma mchis lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/'di ltar gang yangs6)'jug pa'am/ ldog pa'i chos de dmigs su ma mchis pa'i slad du ste/ 'di ltar chos thams cad gtan mngon par ma grub pa lags pas stong pa nyid ni 'jug par bgyid pa'am/ ldog par bgyid pa ma lags 'dzo/mtshan ma nam mchis pa dang / smon pa ma mchis pa yang 'jug par bgyid pa'am / ldog par bgyid pa ma lags so/ /de ltar na gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bstan pa dang / rab tu bstan pa dang / brjod 6)pa dang /gdags pa dang / 'jug pa dang / rnam par 'grel ba dang / rnam par 'byed pa dang / smos pa dang / gsal bar bgyid pa dang / yang dag par rab tu ston pa 'di ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bstan pa yongs su dag pa lags so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bstan pa de yang sus kyang ma bstan/sus kyang ma bzung lags so/ /gang sus kyang ma bstan sus 47kyang ma bzung kyirte30—202

ba de ni sus ①kyang mngon sum du ma bgyid ②lags so/ /gang sus ①kyang ma bstan gyes kyang ma bzung / sus rlonakyang mngon sum du ma bgyis pa de la ni yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa su yang ma mchis te/ chos bstan pa 'di la su yang sbyin gnas su 'gyur ba yang ma mchis lags so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa khri brgyad stong pa las gnas medabapa'i le'u zhes bya ste sum cu rtsa bdun pa'o // //de nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni ma mchis pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor nam mkha' med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin⑧pa 'di ni mnyam pa nyid lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor chos thams cad dmigs su med par mnyam pa nyid kyi phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni dben pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni rdzi ba ma mchis pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/chos thams cad dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 38—203

'di ni gzhi ma mchis pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ming med pa dang lus med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni nam mkha' lta bu lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dbugs tshiphyi nang du rgyu ba dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni 2brjod du ma mchis pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa / rnam par rtog pa dang / rnam par dpyod pa dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni ming ma mchis pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang ske/ rnam par shes pa'i phung po dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni 'gro ba ma mchis pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos thams cad 'gro ba med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni mi 'phrogs 5pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos thams cad gzung du med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni mi bas pa calags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos thams cad shin tu byang zhing zad pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor 38—204

gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni skye ba ma mchis pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos thams cad kyi skye ba med pa dang / 'gag pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni byed pa0)po ma mchis pa lags sol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ byed pa po dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni shes pa po ma mchis pa lags sol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ shes pasapo dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni 'pho tshib ma mchis pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'chi 'pho dang skye ba dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni 'jig ④pa ma mchis pa lags so / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis 'jig pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni rmi lam lta bu lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rmi lam rmis pa dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni brag calalta bu lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sgra'i brjod pa dmigs su med pa'i phyir 30—205

rol/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni mig yor lta bu lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gzugs brnyan (1modamigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni smig rgyu lta bu lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chu 'bab pa dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni sgyu rin ma lta bu lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mtshan ma dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni gti mug ma mchis pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ma rig pa'i mun pa dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni kun nas nyon mongs pa ma mchis pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun nas nyon mongs pa dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa ri'adi ni rnam par byang ba ma mchis pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun nas nyon mongs pa yod par mi dmigs pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni gnas ma mchis pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos thams cad dmigs 30—206

su med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni dmigs su ma mchis pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gnas dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni spros pa ma mchis pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ spros 31pa thams cad yang dag par bcom pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni rlom sems ma mchis pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rlom sems thams cad yang dag par bcom pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni g.yo ba ma mchis pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/chos kyi zhudabyings gnas pa nyid kyi phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni 'dod chags dang bral ba lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa / chos thams cad ma nor ba de bzhin nyid du mngon par rdzogs par byang chub par byed pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni kun nas ldang ba ma mchis pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos thams cad rnam par rtog pa med pa nyid kyi phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa / bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu 38—207

phyin pa 'di ni zhi ba lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos thams cad mtshan ma med cing dmigs su med pa nyid kyi phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni 'dod chags ma mchis pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'dod chags kyi mtshan ma ①dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa la'adi ni zhe sdang ma mchis pa lags sol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ zhe sdang yod pa mtsha yin pa'i phyir ro// //mashes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa khri brgyad stong pa/ bam po sum cu pa/rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni gti mug ma mchis pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gti mug gi mun pa rnam7par sel ba nyid kyi phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi nya)pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni nyon mongs pa ma mchis pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ yongs su rtog pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni sems can ma mchis pa lags sol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sems can dmigs su med pa nyid kyi phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di〈pelta ste/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni tshad ma mchis pa lags 38—208

so / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos thams cad kun nas ldang ba med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni mtha' gnyis su ma mchis pa0)lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mtha' dmigs su med pa nyid kyi phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni ma 'dres pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos thams cadasa'adres pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni nag nog ma mchis pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi sa las yang dag par 'das pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa / bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni rnam par mi rtog pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rnam par rtog pa dmigs su ⑧med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni tshad ma mchis pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos thams cad kyi tshad dmigs su medasrepa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni nam mkha' lta bu lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos thams cad nam mkha' ltarasngonachags pa med pa'i phyir rol/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi 38—209

pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa nya'adi ni mi rtag pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos thams cad 'jig ②pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa ga'adi ni sdug bsngal ba lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos thams cad lhag par chags par bya ba'i 'os ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni bdag ma mchis pasrelags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos thams cad mngon par zhen pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pasa'adi ni stong pa nyid lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos thams cad kyikherang bzhin dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa7'di ni mtshan nyid ma mchis pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/chos thams cad mtshan ma med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin paphu'adi ni nang stong pa nyid lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/nang gi chos rnams dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni phyi stong pa nyid lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/phyi'i chos rnams dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/38—210

bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni phyi nang stong pa nyid lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/phyi dang ①nang gi chos rnams dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni stong pa nyid stong pa nyid lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni chen po stong pa nyid lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka'7stsal pa/ chen po stong pa nyid dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni don dam pa stong pa nyid lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ don dam pa stong pa nyid dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni 'dus byas stong pa nyid lags so / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'du〈gebyas stong pa nyid dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal 38—211

pal/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa ①nyid lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ thog ma dang tha ma ②med pa stong pa nyid dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni dor ba med pa stong pa nyid lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dor ba med pa stong pa nyid dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni rang bzhin stong pa nyid lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa / 'dusadza dbyas dang 'dus ma byas kyi7chos dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni chos thams cad stong pa nyid lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis 38—212

gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni dngos po med pa stong pa nyid lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dngos po med pa stong pa nyid dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid lags sol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyidakyi/dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni dran pa nye bar gzhag pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lus dang / tshor ba dang / sems dang /chos dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di ②lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni yang dag pa'i gaspong ba lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/dge ④ba dang / mi dge ba'i chos rnams dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pasngona'adi ni rdzu 'phrul gyi 0rkang pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal sepa/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes 38—213

rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni dbang po lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dbang po lnga dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni stobs lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ stobs lnga dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni byang chub kyi yan lag lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ byang chub kyi yan lag bdun dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni lam lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lam yan lag brgyad pa dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni stong pa nyid lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lta bar gyur pa snatshodamigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni mtshan ma ma mchis pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rnam par rtog pa dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni smon pa ma mchis pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ smon lam dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu 38—214

phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni rnam par thar pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rnam par thar pa brgyad dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni snyoms par 'jug pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu dmigs su med pa'i phyir7ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni 'phags pa'i bden pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/sdug bsngal ba dang / kun 'byung ba dang / 'gog pa dang / lam dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni sbyin pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ser sna dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni tshul khrims lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'chal pa'i tshul khrims dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni bzod pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gnod sems dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni brtson 'grus lags so/ /tshibacom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ le lo dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/38—215

bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni bsam gtan lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/g.yeng ba dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni shes rab lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'chal pa'i shes rab dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni stobs bcu lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos0)thams cad dmigs su mimed pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni mi 'jigs pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lam gyi rnam pa tsushes pa nyid dmigs su ④med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni so so yang dag par rig pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ thams cad du ye shes chags pa med cing thogs pa med pa'i phyiras)ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni snying rje chen po lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sems can thams cad yongs su mi gtong ba'i phyir ro / /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa lags so / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs 38—216

rgyas kyi chos thams cad las yang dag par 'das pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni de bzhin nyid lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ brjod pa thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid yin pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni rang byung lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos thams cad la dbang sgyuratuba'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni sangs rgyas lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos thams cad rnam pa thams cad du mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa'i phyir ②ro/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa khri brgyad stong pa las/dmigs su med pa'i le'u zhes bya ste sum cu rtsa brgyad pa'o// //de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin 'di snyam du sems te/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang dag gi rna gulam du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di grag ④pa de dag kyang sngon gyi rgyal ba la lhag par bya ba byas pa yin la/ gang dag gi rna lam du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di grag ⑤par 'gyur ba de dag kyang /de bzhin gshegs pa las dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams bskyed cing / dge ba'i bshesalgeganyen gyis yongs su zin pa 1)yin no/ /gang dag 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang ske/ klog pa dang / kun chub par byed pa dang / bzung zhing bcangs la blags shing 13kun chub par byas nas kyang / de bzhin nyid du sgrub par byed pa 30—217

dag lta smos kyang ci dgos/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs7kyi bu mo〈migang dag shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang /kun chub par byed pa dang / bzung zhing bcangs la blags7shing kun chub par byas nas kyang / de bzhin nyid du sgrub par byed pa de dag gis ni sangs rgyas mang po dag la bsnyen bkur byas pa yin no/ /rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang dag gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di thos nas kyang mi skrag mi dngang zhing / dngang bar mi 'gyur ba de dag gis ni sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams la yang yongs su zhu ba byas pa yin no/ /gang dag gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di thos nas kyang mi skrag mi dngang zhing dngang bar mi 'gyur ba de dag gis ni bskal pa bye ba phrag mang po dag nas ri/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyad cing /tshul khrims dang / bzod pa dang / brtson 'grus dang / bsam gtan dang /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyad pa yin no snyam mo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang dag shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di thos nas mi skrag mi dngang zhing / dngang bar mi 'gyur la/'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par bgyid pa dang / tshul bzhin du yang brtson par bgyid pa'i rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de medag ni phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams ji lta ba de ltar gzung bar bgyid 45lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni zab lags te/ sngon pha rol tu phyin 38—218

pa drug po dag la ma spyad pa dag gis ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la mos par rngo mi thogs hu)pa'i slad du'o/ /bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di spong bar sems pa'i rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de dag gis ni/ sngon gyi mthar yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di spangasalgepa lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das 'di ltar rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la dad pa ma mchis pa dang /dga' ba ma mchis pa dang / dad pa sem mchis pas rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de dag gis sangs rgyas rnams dang / sangs rgyas kyi nyan thos rnams la 'di skad du/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la ni ji ltar spyad par bgyi/ tshul khrims dang / bzod pa dang / brtson 'grus dang / bsam gtan dang /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la ni ji ltar spyad tshogapar bgyi/ nang stong pa nyid la ni ji ltar bsgom par bgyi/ phyi stong pa nyid la ni ji ltar bsgom par bgyi/phyi nang stong pa nyid la ni ji ltar bsgom par bgyi/ dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar la ni ji ltar bsgom par bgyi/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams la ni ji ltar bsgom par bgyi/ yang dag pa'i〈spong ba dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang / dbang po dang / stobs dang / byang chub kyi yan lag dang /lam rnams la ni ji ltar bsgom par bgyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu la ni ji ltar bsgom par bgyi/ mi 'jigs pa rnams dang / so so yang dag par rig pa rnams dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams la ni ji ltar bsgom par bgyi/ zhes yongs su zhu ba ma bgyis pa'i phyi slad du'o/ /de nas lha'i 38—219

dbang po brgya byin gyis tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu la 'di skad ces smras so/ /btsun nyu)pa shā ri'i bu de ltar ngo mtshar〈miyang ci chekhuste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni shin tu zab pas na④/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang sngon gyi mthar yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la mos par ma gyur pa dang / sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / tshul khrims dang / bzod pa dang / brtson 'grus dang / bsam gtan dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mos par ma gyur pa dang / nang stong pa nyid la mos par ma gyur pa dang ske/ dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar la mos par ma gyur pa dang ske/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun la mos par ma gyur pa dang /stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang ske/ mngon par shes pa lnga dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad la mos par ma gyur pa dag gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di spong bar byed pa ni ngo mtshar mi che'o/ /btsun gepa shā ri'i bu gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la phyag 'tshal ba de ni/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi ye shes la phyag 'tshal ba yin pas na/ bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bdag phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis lha'i dbang po brgya byin la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /kau shi ka de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la phyag 'tshal ba de ni/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi ye shes la phyag 'tshal ba yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na / kau shi ka 'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di las nges par byung la/30—220

shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi ye shes kyis rab tu bskyed pa yin pa'i phyir te/ kau shi ka rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la gnas par 'dod pa'i rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mos shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas par bya'o/ /de bzhin du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi ye shes skyed par 'dod pa dang / bag chags kyi mtshams0)sbyor ba dang /nyon mongs pa thams cad yang dag par 'jomasalgepar 'dod pa dang / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'dod pa dang / chos kyi 'khor lo skor dubar 'dod pa'i rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mos kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas par bya'o/ /de bzhin du sems can rnams rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu la dgod par 'dod pa dang /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang / phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang /dgra bcom pa nyid la dgod par 'dod pa dang / rang byang chub la dgod par 'dod pa dang / sems can rnams bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la dgod par 'dod pa dang / dge slong gi dge 'dun yongs su bsdu bar 'dod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rnal 'byor du bya'o/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang /bcom ldan 'das la lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po desnyishis rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas pa lags/ ji ltar na rnal 'byor du bgyid pa lags / ji ltar na bsam gtan dang / brtson 'grus dang / bzod pa dang /tshul khrims dang / sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas pa lags/ ji ltar nadza ge38—221

rnal 'byor du bgyid pa lags/ ji ltar na gyo7shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyad na/ nang stong pa nyid la rnal 'byor du bgyid pa lags/ ji ltar na nadangos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar la rnal 'byor du bgyid pa lagasal/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos ji ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyad na/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun la rnal 'byor du bgyid pa lags/ de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos ji ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyad na/de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / mngon par shes pa lnga dang / sangs rgyas kyisachos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad la rnal 'byor du bgyid pa lags/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis lha'i dbang po brgya byin la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /kau shi ka gang khyod de bzhin gshegs pa la don de yongs su zhu bar sems pa ni legs so legs so/ /kau shi ka khyod kyi spobs pa skyes pa de yang sangs rgyas kyi mthu yin te/ kau shi ka de'i phyir legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zung shig dang / ngas khyod la bshad par bya'o/ /kau shi ka 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa ④gzugs la mi gnas te/ gang gi tshe gzugs la mi gnas pa de'i tshe gzugs la rnal 'byor du byed pa yin no/ /de bzhin du tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang /'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa la mi gnas te/ gang gi tshe rnam par shes pa la mi gnas pa de'i tshe/ rnam par shes pa la rnal 'byor du byed pa yin no / /de bzhin du mig la mi gnas/ rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang /38—222

lus dang / yid la mi gnas te/ de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rnal 'byor du byed do/ /de bzhin du gzugs la mi gnas/ sgra dang / dri dang ske/ ro dang / reg bya dang / chos rnams la mi gnas te/ de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rnal 'byor du byed do/ /de bzhin du sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la mi gnas par shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rnal 'byor du byed do/ /de bzhin du tshul khrims dang / bzod pa dang / brtson 'grus dang ske/ bsam gtan dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mi gnas par shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rnal 'byor du byed do/ /nang stong pa nyid la mi gnas par shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rnal 'byor du byed do/ /dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar la mi gnas par shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rnal 'byor du byed do/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams la mi gnas par shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rnal 'byor du byed do/ /de bzhin du yang dag pa'ispyisrong ba rnams dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams dang / dbang po rnams dang / stobs rnams dang / byang chub kyi yan lag rnams dang / lam la mi gnas par shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rnal 'byor du byed do/ /tshad med pa bzhi la mi gnas par shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rnal 'byor du byed dol/ /bsam gtan bzhi dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi dang ske/ mngon par shes pa lnga la mi gnas/ stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad la mi gnas par shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rnal 'byor du byed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar gang la gnas pa dang gang la 38—223

rnal 'byor du byed pa'i gzugs de dmigs su med pa dang / de bzhin du gang la gnas pa dang / gang la rnal 'byor du byed pa'i tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang ske/ 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa dang / de bzhin du khams rnams dang / skye mched rnams dang / rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba dang /pha rol tu phyin pa rnams dang / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun dang ske/ stong pa nyid thams cad dang / stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa rnams0)dang / so so yang dag par rig pa rnams dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /kau shi ka gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gzugs la sbyor bar mi byed de/ gang gi phyir gzugs la sbyor bar mi byed pa de ltar gzugs la rnal 'byor du byed do/ /de bzhin du tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa la sbyor bar mi byed de/ gang gi phyir rnam par shes pa la sbyor bar mi byed pa de ltar rnam par shes pa la rnal 'byor du byed do/ /de bzhin du khams rnams dang / skye mched rnams dang / rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba dang ske/ pha rol tu phyin pa rnams dang / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun dang / stong pa nyid thams cad dang / stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa rnams dang / so so yang dag par rig pa rnams dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad la sbyor bar mi byed de/ gang gi phyir sangs rgyas kyi chos5 ma 'dres pa bco brgyad la sbyor bar mi byed pa de ltar/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad la rnal 'byor du byed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po des gzugs sngon gyi mthar mi 38—224

dmigs / gzugs phyi ma'i mthar mi dmigs/ gzugs da ltar byung bar mi dmigs shing de bzhin du tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang ske/ rnam par shes pa sngon gyi mthar mi dmigs/ rnam par shes pa phyi ma'i mthar mi dmigs/ rnam par shes pa da ltar byung bar mi dmigs la de bzhin du khams rnams dang / skye mched rnams dang / rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba dang ske/ pha rol tu phyin pa rnams dang / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun dang / stong pa nyid thams cad dang / stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa rnams dang / so so yang dag par rig pa rnams dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad sngon gyi mthar mi dmigs/ phyi ma'i mthar mi dmigs/da ltar byung bar mi dmigs pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni zab pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/shā ri'i bu gzugs kyi de bzhin nyid zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab pa yin no/ /shā ri'i bu de bzhin du tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang /'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa'i de bzhin nyid zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab pa yin no/ /shā ri'i bu de bzhin du khams rnams dang ske/ skye mched rnams dang / rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba dang / pha rol tu phyin pa rnams dang / stong pa nyid thams cad dang / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams dang / stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa rnams dang / so so yang dag par rig pa rnams dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa'i de bzhin nyid zab pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab pa yin no/ /shā ri'i bus 38—225

gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni gting dpag dka' ba lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ shā ri'i bu gzugs gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka' ba yin no/ /shā ri'i bu de bzhin du tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang ske/ 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka' ba yin no/ /shā ri'i bu de bzhin du khams rnams dang / skye mched rnams dang / rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba dang / pha rol tu phyin pa rnams dang / stong pa nyid thams cad dang /byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams dang / stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa rnams dang / so so yang dag par rig pa rnams dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gting dpag dka' ba yin no/ /shā ri'i bus gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni tshad ma mchis pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ shā ri'i bu gzugs tshad med pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad med pa yin no/ /shā ri'i bu7tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang /'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa tshad med pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad med pa yin no/ /shā ri'i bu de bzhin du khams rnams dang /skye mched rnams dang / rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba dang / pha rol tu phyin pa rnams dang / stong pa nyid thams cad dang / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams dang / stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa rnams dang / so so yang dag par rig pa rnams dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams tshad med pa'i 38—226

phyir / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad med pa yin no/ /shā ri'i bus gsol pa / bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gal te/gzugs zab ces bya bar mi7spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa yin no/ /de bzhin du tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang /rnam par shes pa zab ces bya bar mi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa yin no/ /de bzhin du khams rnams dang / skye mched rnams dang /rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba dang / pha rol tu phyin pa rnams dang / stong pa nyid thams cad dang /(ge byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams dang / stobs bcu dang ske/ mi 'jigs pa rnams dang / so so yang dag par rig pa rnams dang /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams zab ces bya bar mi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ shā ri'i bu 'di ltar gzugs kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni gzugs ma yin la/ tshor ba dang /'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pasazab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni rnam par shes pa ma yin zhing / de bzhin du khams rnams dang /skye mched rnams dang / rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba dang / pha rol tu phyin pa rnams dang / stong pa nyid thams cad dang / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams dang / stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa rnams dang / so so yang dag par rig pa rnams dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyi zab pa nyid gang yin pa de ni sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams ma yin no/ /zhes bya ba de ltar yang 38—227

mi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa ni gyo)gal te gzugs gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar mi spyod na/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa yin no/ /gal te tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar mi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa yin no/ /de bzhin du khams rnams dang / skye mched rnams dang / rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba dang / pha rol tu phyin pa rnams dang / stong pa nyid thams cad dang /byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams dang / stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa rnams dang / so so yang dag par rig pa rnams dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams gting dpag dka' zhes bya bar mi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ shā ri'i bu 'di ltar gzugs kyi gting dpag dka' ba nyid gang yin pa de ni gzugs ma yin la/tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa'i gting dpag dka' ba nyid gang yin pa de ni rnam par shes pa ma yin zhing / de bzhin du khams rnams dang / skye mched rnams dang / rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba dang / pha rol tu phyin pa rnams dang / stong pa nyid thams cad dang /byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams dang / stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa rnams dang / so so yang dag par rig pa rnams dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyi gting dpag dka' ba nyid gang yin pa de ni sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams ma yin no zhes bya bar yang mi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin 38—228

pa la spyod pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyi gting dpag dka' ba nyid gang yin pa de ni sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa gal te/ gzugs tshad med do zhes bya bar mi spyod ①na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa yin no/ /de bzhin du tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa tshad med do zhes bya bar mi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ shā ri'i bu 'di ltar gzugs kyi tshad med pa gang yin pa de ni gzugs ma yin la/ tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang /'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pasatshad med pa nyid gang yin pa de ni rnam par shes pa ma yin zhing de bzhin du khams rnams dang / skye mched rnams dang ske/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba dang / pha rol tu phyin pa rnams dang /stong pa nyid thams cad dang / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun dang /stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa rnams dang / so so yang dag par rig pa rnams dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyi tshad med pa nyid gang yin pa de ni sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams ma yin no zhes bya ba de ltar yang mi spyod ②na / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ shā ri'i bu 'di ltar sangs rgyas/ kyi chos rnams kyi tshad med pa nyid gang yin pa de ni sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /shā ri'i bus gsol pa / bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni de tsam du zab pa dang ske/ de tsam du gting dpag dka' ba dang / de tsam du rtogs par dka' 38—229

ba dang / de tsam du tshad ma mchis pa lags te/ bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni theg pa la gsar du zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi mdun du bshad par mi bgyi ste/ de dag gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di thos na skrag cing dngang la dngang bar 'gyur lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di ni phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i mdun du bshad par bgyi ste/ des shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di thos na mi skrag mi dngang 7la dngang bar mi 'gyur zhing ske/ nem nur bgyid par mi 'gyur/ the tshom 'tshal bar mi 'gyur ba'i steng du thos nas kyang mos par 'gyur lags so/ /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu la 'di skad ces smras so/ /btsun ②pa shā ri'i bu theg pa la gsar du zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i mdun du gal te/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di bshad na/ nyesaphupa cir 'gyur/ shā ri'i bus smras pa④/ kau shi ka theg pa la gsar du zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i mdun du gal te/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di bshad par gyur na/ skrag cing dngang la/dngang bar 'gyur zhing / 5)phyir spong bar 'gyur te/ mos par mi 'gyur la/kau shi ka gang gi phyir theg pa la gsar du zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po des shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di thos na phyir spong zhing ske/ log par ltung bar 'gro ba lags yepar 'gyur te/ yun ring pos kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar dka' ba'i gnas de yod do/ /brgya byin gyis smras pa/ btsun pa shā ri'i 38—230

bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen ponyelung ma bstan pa gang dag gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di thos na/ mi skrag mi dngang zhing /dngang bar mi 'gyur ba lta yod dam/ shā ri'i bus smras pa/ kau shi ka byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang dag gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di thos na/ mi skrag mi dngang zhing / dngang bar mi 'gyur ba de dag ni ring po mi thogs par bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan pa 'thob par 'gyur te/ de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa gcig gam/gnyisakhulas mi 'da' ba'i bar gyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan pa 'thob 0par 'gyur ba yin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu la bka' stsal pa/ shā ri'i bu de de bzhin no / /de de bzhin te/ shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang dag gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di thos na/ mi skrag mi dngang zhing / dngang bar mi 'gyur ba'i steng du thos nas kyang 'dzin pa dang /'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par byed cing ji skad bstan pa bzhin du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas par 'gyur ba de dag ni/yun ring po nas theg pa la yang dag par zhugs shing / pha rol tu phyin pa drug la spyod spyod pa dang / sangs rgyas mang po la bsnyen bkur byed byed pa yin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das dper brjod par bdag shin tu spobs lags so/ /bde bar gshegs pa bdag spobs lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/shā ri'i bu khyod spobs par gyis shig /shā ri'i bus gsol pa/ bcom ldan 38—231

'das 'di lta ste dper bgyi na/ theg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugs pa'i rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo zhig gi g.yar lam du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la sgom pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la sgom pa dang /byang chub kyi snying po la mchis pa'i bar dag mis par gyur na/ bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub dang nye bar gyur pa lags par rigs ha)par bgyi na/ bcom ldan 'das gang dag sad pa na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la sgom pa dang /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ske/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ske/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la sgom pa dang / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas shing / mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas kyang / byang chub kyi snying po la mchis shing / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar sems pa'i rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de dag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub dang nye bar 'gyur ba lta smos kyang ci 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang dag gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di mnyan pa'i slad du rnyed cing thos nas kyang /de bzhin nyid du sgrub par bgyid pa de dag ni dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su smin pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang dag shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di thos nas/ 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba 30—232

dang ske/ klog pa dang / kun chub par bgyid pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la bgyid pa de dag ni yun ring po nas theg pa la yang dag par nyu)zhugs pa dang /dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun pa dang / sangs rgyas mang po la bsnyen bkur bgyis pa dang ske/ dge ba'i bshes geganyen gyis yongs su zin pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang du/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang dag gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rnyed par 'gyur zhing / rnyed par gyur nas kyang 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par bgyid pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la bgyid pa'i rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan du nye ba'am/ lung bstan par 'gyur ba'am/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste dper bgyi na/ mi zhig 'brog dgon pasridapag tshad brgya pa zhig nas byung bar gyur tam/ 'brog dgon pa dpag tshad nyis〈nyebargya pa zhig nas sam/ dpag tshad sum brgya pa zhig nas sam/ dpag tshad bzhi brgya pa zhig nas sam/ dpag tshad lnga brgya pa zhig nas byung bar gyur nas/ de byung ba'i tshe grong khyer gyi snga ltas ba lang rdzi dag gam/ phyugs rdzi dag gam sa mtshams sam / kun dga' ra ba'am tshal dag gam/ skyed46)mos tshal dag mthong bar gyur tam/ grong khyer gyi snga ltas grong dag gam/ grong rdal dag gam ljongs dag gam / yul 'khor dag gam mtshan ma gzhan gang yang rung ba dag mthong bar gyur na/ de 'di snyam du snga ltas 'di lta bu 'di dag gda' ba las na/ 'di nas grong dang / grong rdal dang / grong khyer dang / yul 'khor dang / rgyal 30—233

po'i pho brang dang nye bar 'gyur ro snyam nas/ dbugs phyin par 'gyur zhing /de la slan chad ti chom rkun gyis 'jigs pa'am/ gdug pas 'jigs pa'am/gdol pas 'jigs pa'am/ gcan gzan na khro bos 'jigs pa'am/ bkres pa dang skom pas 'jigs pa dag 'byung bar mi 'gyur lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di rnyed par 'gyur zhing rnyed par gyur nas kyang 'dzin par bgyid/ 'chang bar bgyid/ klog par bgyid/ kun chub par bgyid/tshul bzhin du yid la bgyid na/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ni lung bstan du nye ba dang / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyang ring po mi thogs par mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur bar rig par bgyi ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po des nyan thos kyi sa'am/ rang sangs rgyas kyi sas 'jigs par mi bgyid lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen du po des 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la blta ba dang phyag bgyi ba dang bsnyen bkur bgyi ba rnyed cing mnyan du rnyed de / snga ltas de dag mchis pa'i slad du'o/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /shā ri'i bu de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ shā ri'i bu sangs rgyas kyi mthus khyod shin tu spobs par gyis shig /shā ri'i bus gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste dper bgyi na mi zhig rgya mtsho chen po lta 'tshal bar gyur nas de rgya mtsho chen po blta 4)ba'i slad du mchis na ji lta ji ltar rgya mtsho chen po blta ba'i slad du 38—234

mchis pa/ de lta de ltar des yal ga gel0)ba'am/ yal ga gelasaba'i mtshan ma'am / ri'am ri'i mtshan ma dag mthong bar gyur na des 'di ltar rgya mtsho chen po ni 'di nas thag ring ste rgya mtsho chen po ni 'di nas thag nye ba ma lags so snyam du rig par bgyi'o/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ rgya mtsho chen po dang nye ba na yal ga gelam ba'am/ yal ga gel ④ba'i mtshan ma'am/ ri'am ri'i mtshan ma dag ma mchis pa'i slad du'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste dper bgyi na/ mi zhig rgya mtsho chen po lta 'tshal bar gyur nas/ ji lta ji ltar mchis pa de lta de ltar des yal ga gel geba'am/ yal ga gel/ba'i mtshan ma'am/ ri'am ri'i mtshan ma dag ma mthong bar gyur na/ de 'di snyam du rgya mtsho chen po ni 'di nas thag mi ring ngo snyam du sems par 'gyur lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ rgya mtsho chen po dang nye ba na yal ga gel 57 ba'am/ yal ga geladza ba'i mtshan ma'am/ri'am ri'i mtshan ma dag mi gda' ba'i slad du'o/ /mi de'i mig gis rgya mtsho chen po ma mthong du lags kyang / des bdag ni rgya mtsho chen po dang nye bar gyur te / rgya mtsho chen po ni 'di nas thag nye'o/ /rgya mtsho chen po ni 'di nas thag mi ring ngo zhes bgyi bar nges par rtogs lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyan pa dang / 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang /kun chub par bgyid pa des kyang 'di ltar rig par bgyi zhing / 'di ltar bsam par bgyi ste/ bdag de bzhin gshegs pas bskal pa 'di snyed cig gam/bskal pa brgya phrag 'di snyed cig gam/ bskal pa stong phrag 'di snyed cig gam/bskal pa 'bum phrag 'di snyed cig gam/ bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig phrag 'bum 38—235

phrag 'di snyed cig na/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes mngon sum du lung ma bstan kyang ske/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po des bdag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan du nye ba lags so snyam du rig par bgyi'o/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ 'di ltar bdag gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di blta zhing mnyan ①du rnyed la thos nas kyang gzung ba dang /bcang ba dang / klag ②pa dang / kun chub par bgyid pasadang / tshul bzhin du yid la bgyir mchis so snyam du sems pa'i slad du'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ dper bgyi na/ dpyid byung ste/ yal ga 'gel5geb rnams kyi lo ma dang / 'dab ma lhags par gyur pa na/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi mi rnams kyis 'di ltar datswani ring po mi thogs par lo ma dang / me tog dang / 'bras bu dag 'byung bar 'gyur ro snyam du rig par bgyi lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na / 'di ltar yal ga 'gel〈ba rnams la snga ltas7de dag gda' ba'i slad du ste / 'dzam bu'i gling gi mi rnams kyis yal ga 'gel tsho ba rnams la snga ltas de dag mthong nas/ 'di snyam du de'uni ring po mi thogs par lo ma dang / me tog dang / 'bras bu dag 'byung bar 'gyur ro snyam nas/ yid dga' bar 'gyur lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin du gang gi tshe/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di blta ba dang ske/ mnyan pa'i slad du rnyed cing thos nas kyang 'dzin par bgyid/ 'chang bar bgyid/ klog par bgyid/ kun chub par bgyid/ tshul bzhin du yid la bgyid na/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sem/sa dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ni 38—236

dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su smin pa lags par rig par bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo de ni/ sangs rgyas mang po la bsnyen bkur bgyid bgyid pa lags par rig par bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag gis kyang 'di snyam du/ gang gi slad du bdag cag gi7shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di rnyed cing bltar mchis pa dang / mnyan du mchis pa dang / phyag bgyir mchis pa dang / ji skad bstan pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bsgrub ②tu mchis pa las na/bdag cag ni sngon gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba dag gis/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la bsnyen pa lags so snyam du rig par bgyi lags so/ /de na zhugang dag sngon sangs rgyas mthong bar gyur pa'i lha'i bu dag 'di snyam du/sngon gyi byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams la yang lung bstan par 'gyur ba'i snga ltas 'di lta bu de dag byung bar gyur pas na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'di dag kyang / ring po mi thogs par bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan par 'gyur ro snyam nas yiserangs shing rab tu dga' ste/ dga' ba dang yid bde ba skye lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste dper bgyi na/ bud7med sbrum pa ni ji lta ji ltar bu btsa' bar nye ba de lta de ltar de'i lus 'gyur te/ lus ngal ba'i tshor ba chen po skye ba dang / 'chag par mi bgyid pa dang / dran pa chung ba dang / g.yar zas kyi dad chung ba dang / rmugasalgepa dang / gnyid chung ba dang / tshor ba de lta bu dag byung bas smra ba nyung ba dang / des sngon tshul bzhin ma lags pa yid la bgyis shing bsten pa dang / lan mang du bgyis shing kun du bston pas 38—237

'di lta bu'i tshor ba 'di dag nyams su myong ngo snyam du rtogs nas/ mi sten ①pa'i ngang tshul can du 'gyur zhing / bud med gzhan dag gis kyang / bud med de'i mtshan ma gang lags pa de dag mthong nas/ 'di snyam du bud med 'di ni ring po mi thogs par bu btsa' bar 'gyur ro zhes rtogs par 'gyur lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun pa/ sangs rgyas mang po la bsnyen bkur bgyis pa spyod pa legs parakhuspyad pa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su zin pa dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su smin pa dag shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zabashemo 'di rnyed cing rnyed nas kyang / 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang /kun chub par bgyid pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la bgyid pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag kyang ring po mi thogs par/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan par 'gyur bar rig par bgyi lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ shā ri'i bu khyod spobs pa skyes pa 'di ni sangs rgyas kyi mthu yin te/ shā ri'i bu legs so legs sol// // 'phags pa7shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa khri brgyad stong pa/ bam po sum cu rtsa gcig pa/ de nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams la sman⑧btags pa ni ngo mtshar lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems 38—238

dpa' chen po rnams ni skye bo mang po la phan pa dang / skye bo mang po la bde ba dang / 'jig rten la snying brtse ba dang / lha dang mi rnams kyi skye bo phal po che'i don dang / phan pa dang bde ba'i phyir/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu zhugs pa yin te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag spyad pa spyod pa na/ bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi po sbyin pa dang /snyan par smra ba dang / don 'thun pa dang / don spyad7pa dag gis byang chub sems dpa' stong phrag mang po dag la phan 'dogs shing / sems can rnams kyang dge ba bcu'i las kyikhulam ①rnams yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug pa dang /bsam gtan bzhi dang / tshad med pa bzhi dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug cing / bdag kyang chos de dag la gnas par byed do/ /bdag kyang sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / gzhan dag kyang sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug go/ /bdag kyang tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / gzhan dag kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug ste/ de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la brten cing / thabs la mkhas pas sems can rnams rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu la 'god par byed kyang / bdag nyid kyis mngon sum du ni mi byed do/ /de bzhin du lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang ske/ phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang / dgra bcom pa nyid dang / rang byang chub la 'god par byed kyang bdag nyid kyang rang byang chub mngon sum du mi 38—239

byed do/ /bdag kyang phyir mi ldog pa'i sa gnon par byed cing / gzhan dag kyang phyir mi ldog pa'i sa la 'god par byed do/ /de bdag kyang sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par byed cing / byang chub sems dpa' gzhan dag kyang /sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par bya ba yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug go/ /bdag kyang sems can rnams yongs su smin par byed cing / gzhan dag kyang sems can rnams yongs su smin par bya ba yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug go/ /bdag kyang mngon par shes pa rnams skyed par byed cing / gzhan dag kyang mngon par shes pa rnams thob par bya ba yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug go/ /bdag kyang gzungs kyi sgo yongs su dag par byed cing / gzhan dag kyang gzungs kyi sgo yongs su dag par bya ba la yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug go/ /bdag kyang spobs pa phun sum tshogs pa thob par byed cing / gzhan dag kyang spobs pa phun sum tshogs pa yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug go/ /bdag kyang gzugs phun sum tshogs pa yongs su 'dzin par byed cing / gzhan dag kyang gzugs phun sum tshogs pa thob par bya ba yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug go/ /bdag kyang mtshan phun sum tshogs pa yongs su 'dzin par byed cing / gzhan dag kyang mtshan phun sum tshogs pa thob par bya ba yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug go / /bdag kyang gzhon nur gyur pa phun sum tshogs pa yongs su 'dzin par byed cing / gzhan dag kyang gzhon nur gyur pa phun sum tshogs pa thob par bya ba yang dag par 'dzin du sti'ajug go/ /bdag kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams sgrub par byed cing / gzhan dag kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams bsgrubalgepar bya ba yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug go/ /bdag kyang 30—240

bsam gtan bzhi skyed par byed cing / gzhan dag kyang bsam gtan bzhi bskyed par bya ba yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug go/ /bdag kyang tshad med pa bzhi dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi skyed par byed cing / gzhan dag kyang so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi thob par bya ba yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug go/ /bdag kyang sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad sgrub7par byed cing / gzhan dag kyang sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug go/ /bdag kyang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par byed cing / gzhan dag kyang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug go/ /bdag kyange bag chags dang mtshams5)sbyor ba dang / nyon mongs pa thams cad spong bar byed cing / gzhan dag kyang bag chags dang / mtshams〈sbyor ba dang / nyon mongs pa thams cad spang bar bya ba yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug go/ /bdag kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar byed cing / gzhan dag kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par byang chub par bya bar yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug go/ /bdag kyang chos kyi 'khor lo skor dubar byed cing / gzhan dag kyang chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug go/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang dag sems can rnams kyi slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa ni/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya zhing / yon 38—241

tan mang po dang ldan pa ni ngo mtshar ①lags so/ /bde bar gshegs pa ngo mtshar lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ba lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa na/ gzugs kyi rnam par 'phel ba yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ba dang ske/ tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa'i rnam par 'phel ba yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ba de'i tshe/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa yongs su rdzogs pa yin no/ /de bzhin du khams rnams dang / skye mched rnams dang / rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba dang / pha rol tu phyin pa rnams dang / stong pa nyid thams cad dang / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams dang / stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa rnams dang / so so yang dag par rig pa rnams dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi rnam par 'phel ba ②yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ba de'i tshe/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa yongs su rdzogs pa yin no/ /rab 'byor gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa na/ gzugs kyi yongs su 'grib pa yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ba dang ske/ tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa'i yongs su 'grib pa yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ba de'i tshe/ byang 38—242

chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa yongs su rdzogs pa yin no/ /de bzhin du khams rnams dang / skye mched rnams dang / rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba dang / pha rol tu phyin pa rnams dang / stong pa nyid thams cad dang / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams dang / stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa rnams dang / so so yang dag par rig pa rnams dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi yongs su 'grib pa yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ba de'i tshe/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa yongs su rdzogs pa yin no/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa na/ chos zhes7bya bar yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ngo chos ma yin zhes bya bar yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ②/ 'das pa zhes bya bar yang dag par rjes su mi mthong / ma 'ongs pa zhes bya bar yang dag par rjes su mi mthong / da ltar byung ba zhes bya bar yang dag par rjes su mi mthong / dge ba dang mi dge ba dang / lung bstan du yod pa dang / lung du ma bstan pa zhes bya bar yang dag par rjes su mi mthong / 'dus7byas dang / 'dus ma byas zhes dubya bar yang dag par rjes su mi mthong / 'dod pa'i khams yang dag par rjes su mi mthong / gzugs kyi khams yang dag par rjes su mi mthong /gzugs med pa'i khams yang dag par rjes su mi mthong / sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yang dag par rjes su mi mthong / tshul khrims dang / bzod pa dang /brtson 'grus dang / bsam gtan dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang 38—243

dag par rjes su mi mthong / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi bar du yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ba de'i tshe/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi7shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa yongs su rdzogs pa yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor 'di ltar chos rnams kyi chos kyi mtshan nyid ni phyir mi ldog pa nyid dang / gsog nyid dang / gsob nyid dang / snying po med pa nyid dang / ya ma brla ②nyid yin pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor gzugs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i phyir/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa yin no/ /rab 'byor tshor ba dang /'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i phyir/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa yin no/ /rab 'byor sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i phyir/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa yin no/ /de bzhin du tshul khrims dang / bzod pa dang / brtson 'grus dang ske/ bsam gtan dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i phyir/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa yin no/ /de bzhin du khams rnams dang / skye mched rnams dang / rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba dang /pha rol tu phyin pa rnams dang / stong pa nyid thams cad dang / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun dang / stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa rnams dang / so so yang dag par rig pa rnams dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi bar du bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i phyir/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa yin no/ /rab 'byor gal 30—244

te byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa/ gzugs bsam gyis mi khyab ces bya bar kun tu shes par mi byed/tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnamasatudang / rnam par shes pa bsam gyis mi khyab ces bya bar kun tu shes par mi byed na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa yongs su rdzogs pa yin no/ /gal te khams rnams dang /skye mched rnams dang / rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba dang / pha rol tu phyin pa rnams dang / stong pa nyid thams cad dang / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams dang / stobs rnams dang / mi 'jigs pa rnams dang / so so yang dag par rig pa rnams dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams dang /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid bsam gyis mi khyab ces bya bar kun du shes par mi byed na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa yongs su rdzogs pa yin no/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la su dag mos par 'gyur lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor gang dag sngon pha rol tu phyin pa drug la spyod spyod pa dang /de bzhin gshegs pa la dge ba'i rtsa ba skyed skyed pa dang / sangs rgyas mang po la bsnyen bkur byed byed pa dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyenakhugyis yongs su zin pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la mos par 'gyur ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das ji tsam gyis na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pha rol tu phyin pa drug la spyod7cing / de bzhin gshegs pa lasashedage ba'i rtsa ba bskrun ⑤pa dang / sangs rgyas mang po la ⑥bsnyen bkur bgyis pa dang /38—245

dge ba'i bshesatuganyen gyis yongs su zin pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa ni gzugs su mi rtog rnam par mi rtog go / /gzugs kyi mtshan mar mi rtog rnam par mi rtog go/ /gzugs kyi rang bzhin du mi rtog rnam par mi rtog go/ /tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes par mi rtog rnam par mi rtog go/ /rnam par shes pa'i mtshan mar mi rtog rnam par mi rtog go/ /rnam par shes pa'i rang bzhin du mi rtog rnam par mi rtog go/ /de bzhin du khams rnams dang / skye mched rnams dang / rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba dang / 'dod pa dang /gzugs dang / gzugs med pa'i khams dang / sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang ske/ tshul khrims dang / bzod pa dang / brtson 'grus dang / bsam gtan dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / nang stong pa nyid dang /dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa dang / yang dag par〈spong ba dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang / dbang po dang / stobs dang / byang chub kyi yan lag dang / lam dang / stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams su mi rtog rnam par mi rtog go/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi bar du mi rtog rnam par mi rtog go/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi mtshan mar mi rtog rnam par mi rtog go/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi rang bzhin du mi rtog rnam par mi rtog go/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/rab 'byor 'di ltar gzugs ni bsam gyis mi khyab/ tshor ba dang / 'du shes 38—246

dang ske/ 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa yang bsam gyis mi khyab la/de bzhin du khams rnams dang / skye mched rnams dang / rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba dang / pha rol tu phyin pa rnams dang / stong pa nyid thams cad dang /byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams dang / stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa dang ske/ so so yang dag par rig pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa dang ske/ rnam7pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyang bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i phyir te/rab 'byor de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pha rol tu phyin pa drug la spyad ②cing de bzhin gshegs pa las dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa dang /sangs rgyas mang po la bsnyen bkur byas pa dang / dge ba'i bshesalgeganyen gyis yongs su zin pa yin no/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das gzugs zab pa'i slad du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab pa lags so/ /tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa zab pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab pa lags so/ /de bzhin du khams rnams dang / skye mched rnams dang / rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba dang ske/ pha rol tu phyin pa rnams dang / stong pa nyid thams cad dang / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams dang / stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa zab pa'i slad du/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab pa lags so/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid zab pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu dang ske/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang / phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu 38—247

dang ske/ dgra bcom pa nyid dang / rang byang chub dang / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che dag skyed par bgyid pas/ rin po che'i phung po lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni chos kyi 'khor lo skor7bar bgyid pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni chos thams cad kyi dag pa'i phung po lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor gzugs dag pa nyid dang / tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa dag pa nyid dang / khams dang / skye mched dang / rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba dang ske/ pha rol tu phyin pa dang / stong pa nyid thams cad dang / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos dang / stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dag pa nyid kyi phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa /bcom ldan 'das 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di bshad pa na bar chad mang po mi 'byung ba ni ngo mtsharasrelags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la ni bar chad mang ①ste/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di yi ger 'dri ba dang /ston pa dang / klog pa dang / 'chad pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa dang ske/ sgom par byed pa dag gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di yi ger 'dri ba dang / bklag 40pa dang / bstan pa dang / bshad pa dang /tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa'i bar dag la bar chad 'byung bar mi 'gyur bar 38—248

myur ba nyid du yi ger bri bar bya zhing myur ba nyid du bsgom par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo des gal te shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di zla ba gcig gis yi ger bri bar byasalgen yang des de bzhin du yi ger bri bar bya/ gal te zla ba gnyis sam/ gsuma'am/bzhi'amanyaske/ lnga'am/ drug gam/ bdun nam lo'i bar gyis yi ger bri bar bya na yang des de bzhin du yi ger bri bar bya/ gal te lo'i bar gyis bshad pa dang ske/ kha ton⑧du bya ba dang / rab tu bstan par bya ba dang / tshul bzhin du yid la bya ba dang bsgom par bya na yang des de bzhin du bsgom par bya ba'i phyir ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor rin po che chen po 'di lasnyibar chad mang du 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das bdudakyisdig can 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di yi ger mi bri ba dang / mi klag7pa dang / kha tonashedu mi bgyi bsnyedang /tshul bzhin du yid la mi bgyi btudang / bsgom par mi bgyi ba'i slad du bar chad bgyid par mi 'gyur lags sam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/rab 'byor bdud sdig can ni 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di ci nas kyang yi ger mi bri ba dang / mi klag 4) pa dang / kha ton du mi bya ba tunyedang / mi bsgom par bya ba'i bar gyi phyir bar chad bya bar brtson tsomod kyi/'on kyang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di yi ger 'dri ba dang / klog pa dang / kha ton du byed pa dang /tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa dang / sgom pa rnams la bar chad byed mi nus so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus 'di skad ces gsol to/ /38—249
